words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 救命啊！有人掉进水里了！(Jiùmìng a! Yǒu rén diào jìn shuǐ lǐ le!) — Help! Someone fell into the water!

words.English Meaning: to report to the police / call 110
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 遇到紧急危险情况请立即报警。(Yùdào jǐnjí wēixiǎn qíngkuàng qǐng lìjí bàojǐng.) — In an emergency or danger, please call the police immediately.
警察很快赶到了现场处理事故。(Jǐngchá hěn kuài gǎndào le xiànchǎng chǔlǐ shìgù.) — Police arrived quickly at the scene to handle the accident.
雷雨天气站在大树下非常危险。(Léiyǔ tiānqì zhàn zài dàshù xià fēicháng wēixiǎn.) — Standing under large trees in a thunderstorm is very dangerous.
出门在外一定要注意人身安全。(Chūmén zàiwài yídìng yào zhùyì rénshēn ānquán.) — Always pay attention to personal safety when traveling.
不好了，我的钱包和证件丢了。(Bù hǎo le, wǒ de qiánbāo hé zhèngjiàn diū le.) — Oh no, my wallet and ID cards are lost.
他突然肚子剧痛，赶紧送急诊。(Tā tūrán dùzi jùtòng, gǎnjǐn sòng jízhěn.) — He suddenly had severe abdominal pain, rush him to the ER.

words.English Meaning: to register (at a hospital) / get a queue number
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 去医院看病先在一楼窗口挂号。(Qù yīyuàn kànbìng xiān zài yī lóu chuāngkǒu guàhào.) — When seeing a doctor at the hospital, register first at the 1st-floor counter.

words.English Meaning: to see a doctor / to examine a patient
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 如果持续发烧，最好去医院看病。(Rúguǒ chíxù fāshāo, zuìhǎo qù yīyuàn kànbìng.) — If the fever persists, it's best to see a doctor at the hospital.
医生给你开了三天的感冒药。(Yīshēng gěi nǐ kāi le sān tiān de gǎnmàoyào.) — The doctor prescribed three days of cold medicine for you.
这个药需要饭后半小时吃药。(Zhè ge yào xūyào fànhòu bàn xiǎoshí chīyào.) — This medicine should be taken half an hour after meals.
他量了体温，发烧到三十八度五。(Tā liáng le tǐwēn, fāshāo dào sānshíbā dù wǔ.) — He took his temperature and had a fever of 38.5°C.
他最近几天喉咙痒，一直咳嗽。(Tā zuìjìn jǐ tiān hóulóng yǎng, yìzhí késou.) — His throat has been itchy and he's been coughing continuously.
昨晚没睡好，今天早上头疼得厉害。(Zuówǎn méi shuì hǎo, jīntiān zǎoshang tóuténg de lìhai.) — I didn't sleep well last night, so I have a bad headache this morning.
可能吃了不干净的东西，我肚子疼。(Kěnéng chī le bù gānjìng de dōngxi, wǒ dùzi téng.) — Maybe I ate something unclean, my stomach hurts.
吹了冷风后他就开始打喷嚏流鼻涕。(Chuī le lěngfēng hòu tā jiù kāishǐ dǎpēntì liú bítì.) — After catching cold wind he started sneezing and having a runny nose.
我对花生严重过敏，菜里不能放。(Wǒ duì huāshēng yánzhòng guòmǐn, cài lǐ bù néng fàng.) — I am severely allergic to peanuts, none in the food please.

words.English Meaning: to check / to examine / medical examination
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 医生建议做一次全面的身体检查。(Yīshēng jiànyì zuò yí cì quánmiàn de shēntǐ jiǎnchá.) — The doctor recommended having a comprehensive physical checkup.
护士打针手法很轻，一点都不疼。(Hùshi dǎzhēn shǒufǎ hěn qīng, yìdiǎn dōu bù téng.) — The nurse gave the injection very gently, it didn't hurt at all.
幸好只是普通感冒，并不严重。(Xìnghǎo zhǐ shì pǔtōng gǎnmào, bìng bù yánzhòng.) — Fortunately it's just a common cold, not serious.
发高烧全身无力，感觉很难受。(Fā gāoshāo quánshēn wúlì, gǎnjué hěn nánshòu.) — With a high fever and weakness all over, I feel very uncomfortable.
祝你早日康复，重返工作岗位！(Zhù nǐ zǎorì kāngfù, chóngfǎn gōngzuò gǎngwèi!) — Wish you a speedy recovery and return to work!

words.English Meaning: careful / to be careful / watch out
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 地上有水很滑，请小心行走。(Dìshang yǒu shuǐ hěn huá, qǐng xiǎoxīn xíngzǒu.) — The floor is wet and slippery, please walk carefully.

words.English Meaning: to fall down / to trip and fall
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 下雪天路滑，老人走路要防止摔倒。(Xiàxuětiān lù huá, lǎorén zǒulù yào fángzhǐ shuāidǎo.) — Snowy roads are slick, seniors should be careful not to fall.
切菜不小心划伤了手指，正在流血。(Qiēcài bù xiǎoxīn huàshāng le shǒuzhǐ, zhèngzài liúxiě.) — Accidentally cut a finger while slicing food, it's bleeding.
